review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this frozen pending-decision case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, repository identity/base commit, paired-case identity, and implementation-owner binding agree with the original specification. DEC-001 is material and explicitly unresolved: the recommended behavior is conditional, not authorization to select OPT-1. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness at decisions, with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, repository/requirements/decisions evidence, and no task or assignment expectations. The empty team catalog does not require an additional later-stage blocker because the deterministic decision gate precedes scenario review and assignment. src/index.ts owns both the runtime implementation and public interfaces; the supplied tests define the regression and type-checking scope. Package configuration, CI ordering, ignore rules, and fixed upstream build-source evidence support treating index.d.ts and dist as generated artifacts rather than separately maintained owners, and support rebuilding before checking root-importing tests. The release-input fingerprints and model, policy, sampling, and budget fields match between Gold and preview. The differing manifest and evaluation source digests, and original versus saved PRD digests, have explicitly documented domains and normalization with Service-supplied mechanical binding evidence. Original-specification readiness flags describe preparation state rather than a conflicting release freeze. This review relies solely on the supplied specification, evidence, and Service provenance; I did not recompute digests, execute code, infer human confirmation, or use candidate outputs.
